ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels covering approximately 92% of the surface; high-intensity (white) pixels localized to scarring and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across both lobes; high-contrast white clusters localized at [distal-left, distal-right] tips; scattered white linear pixel chains across both fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a rounded vertex; internal pixel angle approximately 45-50 degrees; depth relative to lobe height is approximately 1:6.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing edge boundary with low-amplitude irregular serrations; pixel amplitude variations of 1-4 pixels visible across the entire span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, representing heavy barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions; prominent parallel rake marks on the lower-left lobe and intersecting diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of barnacles on distal tips; extensive white linear scarring/rake marks across the ventral surface area.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white barnacle 'caps' at the extreme ends of the fluke lobes creating high visual contrast against the dark pigmentation.
